The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Monday, May 1, 1933

Extradition Problem Remains
Puzzle Regarding Shanghai

Frequently it is stated that Shanghai forms a sanctuary for fugitives from justice from all parts of the world. There is some element of truth in this, as is evident in the present Julian case.
The question of extradition from this city is apparently a fairly perplexed one.
From countries which have no extradition treaty, it is obvious that the alleged criminal is perfectly safe. But even for lands which have such a treaty little is known to the man in the street here as to whether it can be applied or not.
Extradition treaties are very general in purport, and it remains for each country to formulate measures for application.
Certain countries with nationals in Shanghai have drafted instruments so that they can be exercised specifically in this city. Extradition to and from the United States, for example, has been accomplished on various occasions.
Some of the perplexity attaching to this question may be lessened, authorities consulted by the Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury pointed out today, if it is remembered that three main instances may be quoted where extradition is impossible in Shanghai.
The first is obviously where a crime is committed in a country which has no extradition treaty; the second is where the offence takes place in a country which has an extradition treaty with the country of origin of the criminal, but which has not worded the treaty so that it includes the city of Shanghai; the third is where the offence which has taken place has no parallel in the country of origin of the perpetrator, although both countries have extradition treaties.
It is therefore clear that one solution to the mystery as to why Mr. C. C. Julian cannot be extradited, although America and Britain have an extradition treaty, is that the legislation under which it can be put into force has not been worded in a way to cover Shanghai.
It was at first thought that he was an American citizen, but it was afterwards declared that he had been born in Canada, and had a British passport.
Therefore it has been argued that he cannot be extradited since his offence was using the U.S. mails for the purpose of defrauding the public, and in Great Britain there is no corresponding crime.

引渡问题仍是
上海的一个谜团

人们常说，上海是世界各地逃犯的避难所。这一点有一定的真实性，目前的朱利安案便显而易见。
从本市引渡罪犯的问题显然相当令人困惑。
对于没有引渡条约的国家，显然所谓的罪犯是绝对安全的。但即使是对于那些有条约的国家，这里的普通民众也几乎不知道这些条约是否适用。
引渡条约的宗旨通常非常笼统，具体实施措施有待各国自行制定。
某些在上海拥有本国国民的国家已起草了相关文书，以便能在本市具体执行。例如，与美国之间的相互引渡已在多个场合得以实现。
《上海晚邮报与水星报》今日咨询的有关当局指出，如果记住在上海无法进行引渡的三种主要情况，与此问题相关的一些困惑或许可以减轻。
第一种情况显然是罪行发生在没有引渡条约的国家；第二种情况是罪行发生在与罪犯原籍国订有引渡条约、但该条约的措辞并未将上海市包括在内的国家；第三种情况是所发生的罪行在罪犯原籍国没有对应的罪名，尽管两国之间订有引渡条约。
因此，关于为何C. C. 朱利安先生虽在美英之间存在引渡条约的情况下仍无法被引渡这一谜团，一个明显的解释是，使该条约得以执行的立法在措辞上并未涵盖上海。
起初人们认为他是美国公民，但后来宣称他出生于加拿大，并持有英国护照。
因此有人辩称，由于他的罪行是利用美国邮政系统欺诈公众，而英国并无相应的罪名，故他不能被引渡。

C. C. JULIAN'S OWN STORY

Powerful Enemies Blamed For Company
Promoter's Difficulties

In a special interview with the "North-China Daily News" yesterday, Mr. C. C. Julian, American company promoter, broke silence on the accusations levelled against him following his departure from Oklahoma City on the eve of his trial, set for February 6, on a charge of using the mails to defraud. This court action arose in connection with the promotion of the C. C. Julian Oil and Royalties Company. Julian, who forfeited bail of G.$25,000, and for whose arrest a warrant was at that time issued, was believed to have fled to Canada, until the recent discovery of his presence in Shanghai.

Shortly before receiving a reporter at the Metropole Hotel, Julian had faced a "talkie" cinema apparatus on the hotel roof for the purpose of recording a statement in which, he said, he stated how fine a city he thought Shanghai, and added that he regarded the United States as a "good place to be out of at the present time." The film is expected to be shown in America shortly.

In his own story Julian traced his rise to a position of prominence in Southwest and Pacific Coast business, and gave what he claims to be the true facts as to the subsequence financial difficulties in which he was involved.

"I was introduced into the United States with a ten years' period in overalls and a leather collar in the California oil fields, during which I went through every piece of manual labour that one has to do to qualify as a driller, a superintendent, and a generally practical oil operator," said Julian. "After ten years in different Californian fields I went to Texas on a contract with the Union Oil Co. to drill twenty-five wells, and after two and a half years returned to California and began operations for myself in Huntington Beach and at Santa Fe Springs.

Californian Oil Wells

"I came out in the newspapers stating to the public that I knew all about the oil business, but was without funds, and was desirous of carrying on a drilling campaign. The public freely responded, and in the period of one year I drilled a dozen of the largest wells ever brought in in California on the Santa Fe Springs field, and got returns out of which I paid to my investors many millions of dollars. Several out of which I paid at the rate of 50 per cent. a month for a period of two years.

"But in the latter part of the period the major companies invoked regulations to curtail production, and inasmuch as I had eight or nine wells ready to be brought in, they refused to buy my oil. There were many thousands of people interested in these ventures, and they naturally expected returns, and the only solution to my problem was to build facilities to handle the production I had ready to bring in. Consequently I formed the Julian Petroleum Corporation a Delaware company capitalised at $30,000,000.

"To sell a security in California it is necessary first to get the permission of what is known as the Corporation commissioner. I presented my plan to the Commissioner, showing him that at the time I had a daily production of 35,000 barrels of oil with perhaps twice that amount of production ready to turn into the pipelines. He immediately acquiesced in the legitimacy of my programme and issued a permit to sell $5,000,000 worth of stock, with the promise that as quickly as I sold the first 5,000,000 he would issue a permit for another 5,000,000 and continue such procedure to the extent of the capitalisation of my company.

Share Issue Checked

"The first 5,000,000 was subscribed in 37 days," Julian declared. On my applying for the second permit he definitely refused to issue further permission to offer shares in my company. In the meantime I had acquired 50 sites and built 50 service stations in Los Angeles, built an outlet at Los Angeles harbour the cost of which was $1,100,000 and which facility allowed me to ship as many as 300,000 barrel tankers simultaneously. I was carrying on a drilling campaign in the different fields, from ten to twenty wells continuously. I built a refinery capable of a daily capacity of 10,000 barrels, ran pipelines from all the South Californian fields to my outlet at Los Angeles harbour, and was shipping crude in large quantities to the Orient, England, France, Germany, and even back to the Atlantic Coast.

"Buying and selling crude in competition with the major companies created their enmity to the extent that through pressure from hidden sources my operations necessitated more capital than the one permit afforded. After about eighteen months of severe pressure, to protect the investment of some 50,000 stockholders, I was faced with the alternative of either having my company go into receivership or turning it over to people who could supply the necessary capital that my programme of operations demanded. On December 28, 1924, after holding a meeting of my shareholders which numbered some 40,000 present, I submitted a proposition of turning control of the Julian Petroleum Corp. to a body of highly representative men and after approval by the shareholders control was turned.

Mr. Julian mentioned the names of prominent figures whom, he said, were daily interested in negotiations for turning over control.

Result of Audit

"Before actually turning control, as precautionary measure I called in Price Waterhouse with a force of eighteen accountants who worked for some three weeks on a complete audit of the company's books, on completion of which they wrote me a letter stating that they were handing me what they termed their unqualified correct statement, and adding that only once in a long time did they have the pleasure of so responding, the promoter continued "I had the assets of my company appraised independently, the result of which was a valuation of $58.58 for each share of preferred stock, which shares originally sold at $50. In turning over my company their bank balance was something over $500,000, some 2,000,000 barrels of oil being in storage, with the company having no liabilities other than monthly current expenses.

"I insisted on an agreement that for a period of one year no property or asset of the company would be hypothecated, mortgaged, or borrowed against, which contract of claim was broken within the first few months. Some two years later the newspapers of California broke with the startling headline of "Crash of the Julian Petroleum Corp." From the date of turning control until the crash of the company I had not even visited their offices more than two or three times, and in these instances it was to protest against the violation of the above mentioned contract.

"Within a few days of the crash it became public news that the stock of the company had been over-issued to the extent of $100,000,000. After an independent investigation by myself, through which I learned the names of the individuals who had profited by this great over-issue of shares, I called on the newspapers of Los Angeles with the demand that they publish their names and the manner in which each was implicated but without success.

Radio Indictment

Inasmuch as the newspapers refused to publish the story and inasmuch as at that time I owned and operated one of the most powerful radio stations of California, namely KMTR, over this station I announced to the world all the names of those involved and called on the grand jury to indict each and every one, appearing before the grand jury and supplying them with the information wherein each was implicated and to what extent. I called on the District Attorney diligently to prosecute each and every one involved. All of the bankers named appeared after my radio announcements before the receivers who were immediately appointed after the crash, and paid back the amounts they received from the venture, in each instance running into thousands of dollars.

"After many months I was faced with the problem of making a livelihood and, having created the hatred of the most powerful men in California, including the major oil companies, I decided to change my line of endeavour from oil to mining. I organised a company known as the Julian Merger Mines and acquired five different meritorious properties and again raised from the public some $10,000,000 for development of these properties. Through the influence of the severe enemies I had made for myself they brought pressure to bear against my company to bring about a standstill of my operations in several districts, using the tactics of having disgruntled shareholders bring court action such as writs against further operation of my mines which eventually forced my Julian Merger Mines into receivership with continuous unfavourable publicity.

C. C. 朱利安的自述

公司发起人的困境归咎于
强大的敌人

美国公司发起人C. C. 朱利安先生昨日接受《字林西报》特别采访，就其离开俄克拉荷马城后针对他的指控打破了沉默。他原定2月6日受审，罪名是利用邮政系统进行欺诈。这起诉讼与他发起成立C. C. 朱利安石油与特许权公司（C. C. Julian Oil and Royalties Company）有关。朱利安当时放弃了25,000金元的保释金，当局随即签发了逮捕令，人们曾以为他逃往了加拿大，直到最近发现他身在上海。

不久之前，朱利安在大都会酒店（Metropole Hotel）接受记者采访前，曾在酒店屋顶面对一台有声电影摄影机录制了一段声明。他说，他在声明中称赞上海是一座多么美好的城市，并补充说，他认为美国目前是“一个适合离开的地方”。预计这部影片不久将在美国放映。

在他的自述中，朱利安追溯了自己如何在西南部和太平洋沿岸商界崛起至显赫地位，并就随后卷入的财务困难提供了他声称的事实真相。

朱利安说：“我进入美国商界的前十年，是在加利福尼亚油田穿着工装、戴着皮领度过的，在此期间，我从事了成为一名钻井工、监工以及一般实务石油运营商所需的所有体力劳动。在加利福尼亚不同油田工作十年后，我与联合石油公司（Union Oil Co.）签订合同前往德克萨斯州钻探二十五口井，两年半后返回加利福尼亚，开始在亨廷顿海滩（Huntington Beach）和圣菲斯普林斯（Santa Fe Springs）独立经营。”

加利福尼亚油井

“我在报纸上向公众表示，我精通石油业务，但缺乏资金，并希望开展钻探活动。公众积极响应，在一年时间内，我在圣菲斯普林斯油田钻探了加利福尼亚有史以来最大的十几口油井，并获得回报，从中向投资者支付了数百万美元。其中有几笔投资我在两年期间按月支付50%的回报率。

“但在该时期后期，大型石油公司援引法规限制产量，鉴于我有八九口井准备投产，他们拒绝购买我的石油。有成千上万的人关注这些 venture，他们自然期望获得回报，而我解决这一问题的唯一办法是建设设施来处理我已准备好投产的产量。因此，我成立了朱利安石油公司（Julian Petroleum Corporation），这是一家特拉华州公司，资本额为3,000万美元。

“要在加利福尼亚出售证券，首先必须获得所谓‘公司专员’（Corporation commissioner）的许可。我向专员提交了我的计划，向他表明当时我的日产量为35,000桶石油，另有大约两倍的产量准备输入管道。他立即认可了我计划的合法性，并发放了出售价值500万美元股票的许可证，并承诺一旦我售出第一个500万美元，他将再发放另一个500万美元的许可证，并按照此程序继续下去，直至达到我公司的资本额上限。

股票发行受阻

“第一个500万美元在37天内认购完毕，”朱利安宣称。“当我申请第二个许可证时，他明确拒绝进一步批准发行我公司的股票。与此同时，我在洛杉矶收购了50处地块并建立了50个服务站，在洛杉矶港建造了一个耗资110万美元的出口设施，该设施使我能够同时装载多达30万桶的油轮。我在不同油田持续开展钻探活动，始终保持十到二十口井的作业。我建造了一座日处理能力为10,000桶的炼油厂，铺设了从南加利福尼亚各油田到我在洛杉矶港出口设施的管道，并将大量原油运往东方、英国、法国、德国，甚至运回大西洋沿岸。

“与大型公司竞争买卖原油招致了它们的敌意，以至于通过隐蔽来源施加的压力，使得我的运营所需的资本超过了单一许可证所能提供的范围。在经过约十八个月的严峻压力后，为了保护约50,000名股东的投资，我面临两种选择：要么让我的公司进入破产接管程序，要么将其移交给能够提供我的运营计划所需必要资本的人士。1924年12月28日，在召开了一次约有40,000名股东出席的会议后，我提出将朱利安石油公司的控制权移交给一个极具代表性的人物团体，并在获得股东批准后移交了控制权。

朱利安先生提到了几位知名人士的名字，他说这些人每天都参与控制权移交的谈判。

审计结果

“在实际移交控制权之前，作为预防措施，我聘请了普华会计师事务所（Price Waterhouse），由十八名会计师组成团队，对公司的账簿进行了为期约三周的全面审计。审计完成后，他们给我写了一封信，称他们向我提供的是他们所谓的‘无保留意见的正确报表’，并补充说，他们很少有机会如此回应，”这位发起人继续说道，“我还对公司资产进行了独立评估，结果是每股优先股估值为58.58美元，而这些股票最初的售价为50美元。在移交公司时，其银行存款余额超过50万美元，库存石油约200万桶，除每月的日常开支外，公司没有任何负债。

“我坚持达成一项协议，即在一年期内，公司的任何财产或资产不得用于抵押、按揭或借款担保，但该合同条款在最初几个月内就被违反。大约两年后，加利福尼亚的报纸以‘朱利安石油公司崩盘’的惊人标题进行了报道。从移交控制权到公司崩盘期间，我甚至只去过他们的办公室两三次，而且每次去都是为了抗议违反上述合同。

“在公司崩盘后几天内，公众得知公司股票超额发行了1亿美元。经过我个人的独立调查，我查明了从这次大规模超额发行中获利的个人姓名，随后我要求洛杉矶的报纸刊登他们的名字以及每个人涉案的方式，但未获成功。

无线电广播指控

鉴于报纸拒绝刊登这一故事，且当时我拥有并经营着加利福尼亚最强大的广播电台之一，即KMTR电台，我通过该电台向全世界公布了所有涉案人员的姓名，并要求大陪审团起诉每一个人。我出庭向大陪审团提供了每个人涉案情况及程度的信息。我敦促地区检察官积极起诉每一个涉案人员。在我通过广播公布名单后，所有被点名的银行家都出现在公司崩盘后立即任命的接管人面前，并退还了他们从该 venture 中获得的款项，每笔金额均达数千美元。

“数月之后，我面临谋生问题，并且由于得罪了加利福尼亚最有权势的人物，包括大型石油公司，我决定将努力方向从石油转向矿业。我组建了一家名为朱利安合并矿业公司（Julian Merger Mines）的公司，收购了五处不同的优质矿产权益，并再次从公众那里筹集了约1,000万美元用于开发这些矿产。由于我树敌众多，势力强大，他们对我的公司施加压力，导致我在几个地区的运营停滞，他们采用的策略是让不满的股东提起诉讼，例如申请禁令阻止我的矿山进一步运营，这最终迫使我的朱利安合并矿业公司进入破产接管程序，并伴随着持续的不利宣传。

Ventures in Oklahoma
"After these two sad experiences and some fourteen years of my life of no avail, I decided definitely to leave California for good, and as a new location for further operations I went to Oklahoma, where probably the greatest oil field in the world, the Oklahoma City Oilfield, had just been opened. Going into this field in the early stages with a few thousand dollars, I selected and purchased 15 properties and while all of them were more than a mile and a half from developed production they turned out to be in the most productive part of that great field. I again raised my capital from former California stockholders and began an immediate intensive drilling campaign with the result that in a few months I brought in gusher after gusher, my daily production within eleven months of my arrival in Oklahoma City running more than 100,000 barrels a day.
"With this company, known as the C. C. Julian Oil and Royalties Company, I approached my former stockholders in California through the mail raising approximately $2,-500,000 for the operations above referred to. Less than a week after my first gusher came in Oklahoma, the State Corporation Commission made a ruling that all production be reduced to eight per cent. of the potential, and two weeks later a further ruling that all production be reduced to one-half of one per cent. I challenged the authority of the Commission and for several weeks ran my wells wide open under a writ of prohibition issued by the Supreme Court of Oklahoma. When the case was finally decided the decision granted the Commission power to instigate such rulings as they saw fit. In the meantime, I had been paying my shareholders in California—and this for a period of three months—cash dividends of three per cent. a month. However, when the Supreme Court went against me all production run in the meantime was charged up against me on the basis of one-half of one per cent. a month, which meant it would be many years before I could again run a barrel of oil.

Militia Called Out!
"The Governor of Oklahoma, Alfalfa Bill Murray, called out the militia to patrol the field. In my letters to my shareholders in California after I had determined that my holdings would prove highly productive, I had definitely stated that they could depend on regular monthly dividends for years to come, and after eleven months operations I employed three different independent engineering firms to appraise the assets of my C. C. Julian Company, the result of the appraisal being $10,900,000 for an investment of $2,500,000, with the engineering firms basing their valuation on the fact that an operator was only permitted to run one half of one per cent.
"Having experienced the difficulty of running a large oil company with limited capital myself, I would never allow my company to become indebted to anyone, believing only through indebtedness could my company interests be hurt. However, I was rudely awakened on this score, to the extent that three small shareholders applied for a receiver for my company, and without notification of any kind a local judge in Oklahoma State on a Saturday at noon signed an order appointing a receiver for my company. The following Monday I went into court and the same judge who signed the order for a receiver vacated his own order. The three people who applied for receivership interviewed many hundreds of my shareholders and eventually succeeded in getting ten more to join them in another application, making thirteen in all with a total investment of $27,000.
Receiver Appointed
"I fought this application through the state courts in Oklahoma and beat the action. They then made the same application in Del Rio County, Texas, where my company had many leases. I again defeated the application for a receiver. The same sources then applied to the Federal Court in Texas with the same application, and I again defeated them. They then returned to Oklahoma and the judge who heard the case and appointed the receiver, making the statement that it was only due to the fact of constant publicity on the request for a receivership that he was acting. The receiver was appointed solely on the application of thirteen stockholders, the total stockholders of my company being 14,700, proxies from 98 per cent. of whom I laid on the table in the courtroom.
"The Federal Government some weeks later, on the contention that I had promised to pay dividends and used the mails as my method of communication, indicted me for using the mails to defraud. In a nutshell, the State Government shut in all my production and the Federal Government indicted me because I did not pay the dividends my letters promised.
"In coming to China, I intend to pursue the endeavour I have spent most of my life in, namely, the production of oil, which the data in my possession assures me exists."

俄克拉荷马州的冒险
“在经历了这两次悲惨的遭遇，以及大约十四年一事无成的生活之后，我决心永远离开加利福尼亚州。为了寻找新的地点以开展进一步的业务，我前往俄克拉荷马州，当时那里刚刚开发了可能是世界上最大的油田——俄克拉荷马城油田。我在早期阶段带着几千美元进入该油田，挑选并购买了15处产业，虽然这些产业距离已开发的产油区都超过一英里半，但结果证明它们位于这个大油田最高产的区域内。我再次从以前的加利福尼亚股东那里筹集资金，并立即开始了密集的钻探活动，结果在几个月内，一口接一口的自喷井相继出油。在我抵达俄克拉荷马城后的十一个月内，我的日产量超过了10万桶。

“通过这家名为 C. C. Julian 石油与特许权使用费公司（C. C. Julian Oil and Royalties Company）的公司，我通过邮件联系我在加利福尼亚的前股东，为上述业务筹集了约2,500,000美元。在我的第一口自喷井在俄克拉荷马州出油后不到一周，州公司委员会作出裁决，将所有产量削减至潜在产量的百分之八；两周后，又作出进一步裁决，将所有产量削减至百分之零点五。我对委员会的权威提出挑战，并在俄克拉荷马州最高法院发布的禁止令下，连续几周让我的油井全开生产。当案件最终判决时，判决赋予委员会权力，可根据其认为适当的情况发起此类裁决。在此期间，我一直向我在加利福尼亚的股东支付现金股息，为期三个月，每月百分之三。然而，当最高法院判决我不利时，期间生产的所有石油都按每月百分之零点五的标准记在我的账上作为违规，这意味着我要过很多年才能再次生产一桶石油。

动员民兵！
“俄克拉荷马州州长阿尔法尔法·比尔·默里（Alfalfa Bill Murray）动员民兵巡逻油田。在我确定我的 holdings 将证明具有高产能力后，我在给加利福尼亚股东的信中明确声明，他们在未来几年可以依赖定期的月度股息。在运营十一个月后，我聘请了三家不同的独立工程公司对 C. C. Julian 公司的资产进行评估，评估结果显示，对于2,500,000美元的投资，其价值为10,900,000美元，工程公司的估值依据是运营商仅被允许运行百分之零点五的产量。

“由于我自己经历过用有限资本运营大型石油公司的困难，我绝不允许我的公司欠任何人债务，因为我坚信只有负债才会损害我公司的利益。然而，在这件事上我被粗暴地唤醒了，以至于三名小股东申请对我的公司进行破产接管，且没有任何通知，俄克拉荷马州的一名地方法官在周六中午签署了一项命令，任命了一名接管人。接下来的周一，我出庭，同一位签署接管令的法官撤销了他自己的命令。申请接管的这三个人会见了我数百名股东，并最终成功说服另外十人加入他们提出另一次申请，总共十三人，总投资额为27,000美元。

任命接管人
“我在俄克拉荷马州的州法院对抗了这一申请并胜诉。随后，他们在得克萨斯州德尔里奥县（Del Rio County）提出了同样的申请，我的公司在该地有许多租约。我再次击败了接管申请。同一批人随后向得克萨斯州的联邦法院提出同样的申请，我再次击败了他们。然后他们回到俄克拉荷马州，审理此案并任命接管人的法官表示，他之所以采取行动，仅仅是因为关于接管请求的持续公开宣传。接管人的任命完全基于十三名股东的申请，而我公司的股东总数为14,700人，我在法庭上出示了其中98%股东的委托书。

“几周后，联邦政府以我承诺支付股息并使用邮件作为沟通方式为由，指控我利用邮件进行欺诈。简而言之，州政府关闭了我所有的生产，而联邦政府则因为我未支付信中承诺的股息而起诉我。

“来到中国，我打算继续从事我大半生致力于的事业，即石油生产，我所掌握的数据向我保证，这里存在石油。”

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Saturday, April 29, 1933

Law And Cynicism
THE ultimate in cynicism appears to have been attained by a visitor in our midst, Mr. C. C. Julian, who not only avails himself of Shanghai's peculiar international status as place of refuge from the clutching hands of the law but who now appeals to Shanghai police for protection against possible illegal gestures toward his person.
It is hardly our province to comment at length upon the matter, for to do so might have the appearance, if not the reality, of judging Mr. Julian's guilt under the indictments awaiting him in America. That is a matter between Mr. Julian and his accusers.
Neither would we wish in the least to suggest that anyone in Shanghai, be he permanent resident or the most transient of transients, is entitled to less than the utmost safeguards Shanghai can provide for both person and property. That is and must be Shanghai's position.
From Mr. Julian's own point of view his position is anomalous in the extreme. On the one hand he shields himself from law, on the other he invokes it, in each case consulting his own convenience alone. Society merely pays the bills.
Decidedly there can be no letting-down of Shanghai's safeguards of the individual in our midst so far as his status under recognized law is concerned.
The situation suggests, however, that some refurbishing of Shanghai's international relations is much in order if this city does not wish specifically to earn for itself a reputation as luxurious hide-out for gentlemen and ladies "wanted" abroad under charges which may be utterly unfounded but which nevertheless require airing in court.

法律与犬儒主义
我们中间的一位访客 C. C. Julian 先生似乎达到了犬儒主义的极致，他不仅利用上海特殊的国际地位作为躲避法律魔爪的避难所，现在还向上海警方求助，以保护其人身免受可能的非法举动侵害。
对此事进行长篇评论并非我们的职责范围，因为这样做可能会给人一种印象，甚至实际上是在对美国待决指控下 Julian 先生的罪行进行审判。这是 Julian 先生与其指控者之间的事。
我们也丝毫不想暗示在上海的任何一个人，无论是永久居民还是最短暂的过客，有权享有少于上海能为人身和财产提供的最高程度保障。这是且必须是上海的立场。
从 Julian 先生自己的角度来看，他的处境极其反常。一方面他躲避法律，另一方面他又援引法律，在每种情况下都只考虑自己的便利。社会 merely pays the bills（仅仅为此买单）。
就我们中间的个人在公认法律下的地位而言，上海对个人的保障绝不能有任何放松。
然而，这种情况表明，如果上海不想特意让自己获得这样一个名声——即为那些在国外被通缉的绅士和女士提供奢华的藏身之处，尽管指控可能毫无根据，但仍需在法庭上澄清——那么整顿上海的国际关系是非常必要的。

THE CHINA PRESS, SATURDAY, APRIL 29, 1933

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
B. REGISTER
410857
30 / 4 p. 3

Julian Seeks Protection Of
Police Here, Fears Kidnapping

Big Shot Fugitive Announces Plans For Making
Geologic Tests For Oil In China, Denies
Interest In Raising Big Fund For Country

By C. D. ALCOTT

Afraid of application of "strong arm" methods to return him to the United States for trial at Oklahoma City on charges of using the United States mails to defraud, C.C. Julian, former head of a U.S. $100,000,000 oil concern on the Pacific Coast, yesterday appealed to the police of the International Settlement for protection. The requested protection was granted.

This move to avoid being returned to America was made after Julian had read newspaper accounts stating that one of the very few means by which he could be returned was by the "grab" route. He has developed a sudden fear of kidnapping, removal aboard a boat bound for the United States and subsequent appearance back in Oklahoma City where he is awaited by the sheriff, the United States Court and 200 angry investors in his C. C. Julian Oil Royalties Company who have filed complaints against him.

In the meantime, he continues to receive newspapermen and other callers in his rooms at the Metropole Hotel. Questioned concerning his move in asking police protection, he stated that he wasn't taking any chances. He wants to remain in China. Asked why he didn't remain in Canada instead of coming to this country, in view of the fact that the American-Canadian extradition treaty does not provide for charges of the kind brought against him he explained that it was because he didn't think he had a future in that country.

"I'm an Oil Man"

"I'm an oil man, and naturally if I had remained in Canada, I should have wanted to have gone into the oil business. Being an independent producer, that would have been difficult, so I came to China."

This statement raised the question concerning the prospects of a future for himself in China.

"I have plans," he declared, in answer to this interrogation, hesitating a moment before becoming more specific. Continuing, he stated that he has every intention of remaining in the oil business, adding that he has some knowledge of mining. At this point, he produced a piece of stone of considerable size from his dressing table and handed it to the interviewer.

"Take a look at that," he said. "It's gold and ninety thousand ounces to the ton!"

The specimen evidently was quite heavy. It was a piece of quartz weighing three or four pounds and encrusted with gold. Asked if there was any more where that came from he was always ready to show it.

No Coal

"How about coal mining?" suggested the interviewer. "There's lots of coal in China."

"No," he said. "If it's anything, it will be oil or gold."

Questioned concerning what plans, if any, he had made for going into the oil business, he stated that he had given the matter considerable thought and that he had even gone so far as to investigate the possibilities of oil being found in China.

"I am sure there is oil in China," he said, "and China needs oil. Perhaps I may be able to find some for her. I don't know but that I would like to try."

Mr. Julian continued that as a matter of fact, his plans have actually developed to the point where he intends doing something about them in the immediate future.

"You may say that I have three or four men on the way to China now to see what they can do about finding oil," he said. "They will arrive in the near future and we shall start in their first place. I was here before I came to China."

作者：C. D. ALCOTT

C.C. Julian 曾是太平洋沿岸一家价值1亿美元的石油企业的负责人，因害怕被采用“强硬手段”遣返回美国，在俄克拉荷马城受审，罪名是利用美国邮件进行欺诈，昨日他向国际租界警方寻求保护。所请求的保护已获批准。

这一避免被遣返回美国的举动，是在 Julian 读到报纸报道后做出的，报道指出他能被遣返的极少数途径之一就是通过“抓捕”路线。他突然产生了被绑架、被带上驶往美国的船只、随后出现在俄克拉荷马城的恐惧，在那里，警长、美国法院以及200名对他提起投诉的 C. C. Julian 石油特许权使用费公司的愤怒投资者正等待着他。

与此同时，他继续在迈特罗波尔酒店（Metropole Hotel）的房间内接待记者和其他访客。当被问及为何寻求警方保护时，他表示他不愿冒任何风险。他想留在中国。当被问及鉴于美加引渡条约不包括对他提出的这类指控，他为何不留在加拿大而来这个国家时，他解释说，因为他认为在那个国家他没有未来。

“我是个石油人”

“我是个石油人，自然而然地，如果我留在加拿大，我会想进入石油行业。作为一名独立生产商，那会很困难，所以我来到了中国。”

这一陈述引发了关于他在中国未来前景的问题。

“我有计划，”他在回答这一询问时宣称，在变得更具体之前犹豫了片刻。接着，他表示他完全打算继续从事石油行业，并补充说他对采矿有一些了解。此时，他从梳妆台上拿出一块相当大的石头，递给采访者。

“看看那个，”他说。“那是黄金，每吨九万盎司！”

这块标本显然相当重。这是一块重达三四磅的石英，上面嵌满了黄金。当被问及是否有更多来自同一来源的矿石时，他总是乐意展示。

没有煤炭

“煤矿开采怎么样？”采访者建议道。“中国有很多煤炭。”

“不，”他说。“如果有话，那就是石油或黄金。”

当被问及他是否制定了进入石油行业的计划时，他表示他已经对此进行了深思熟虑，甚至调查了在中国发现石油的可能性。

“我确信中国有石油，”他说，“而且中国需要石油。也许我能帮她找到一些。我不知道，但我想试试。”

Julian 先生继续说，事实上，他的计划已经发展到他打算在不久的将来采取实际行动的地步。

“你可以说，我现在有三四个人正在来中国的路上，看看他们在寻找石油方面能做些什么，”他说。“他们很快就会到达，我们将首先从他们开始。在我来中国之前我就在这里。”

SHANGHAI, CHINA.

April 27, 1933.

Major F. W. Gerrard, C.I.E.,
Commissioner of Police,

SHANGHAI.

Dear Sir:

On Sunday afternoon, April 23rd, 1933, the
United States Marshal for China, Mr. Porter, accom-
panied by a member of your Police Force visited the
Metropole Hotel for the purpose of arresting one C. C.
Julian, supposed to be an American citizen. Mr. Julian
was indicted at Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, U. S. A., on
December 28, 1931 for the offense of using the United
States Mails in furtherance of a scheme to defraud,
furnished bail in the sum of U.S.$25,000.00, failed to
appear for trial before the United States District Court
for the Western District of Oklahoma on February 6, 1933,
and became a fugitive from justice. Information supplied
by the United States Post Office Department, received at
this office about a week ago, indicated the possibility
of Mr. Julian being in China. The Post Office Department
and Department of Justice requested assistance in effect-
ing his arrest and return to the United States for trial,
if found in China. In attempting to effect the arrest
of Mr. Julian last Sunday afternoon, it was discovered
that he held what purports to be a Canadian passport.
Consequently, the arrest was not effected. For the in-
formation of your Department I am enclosing herewith
a "Wanted" circular consisting of pictures and finger-
prints, and containing other information regarding Mr.
Julian. Mr. Julian is also wanted by the State author-
ities of Oklahoma for embezzlement of U.S.$200,000.00.

At the present time I am endeavoring to
secure definite information regarding Julian's nation-
ality. From information already obtained it appears
that he has been living in the United States for at
least 15 years. I have also been informed, but thus
far have been unable to confirm, that Julian once held
an American passport issued to him under another name.
Several persons who have been closely associated with

Julian 的男子，该人据信为美国公民。Julian 先生于1931年12月28日在美国俄克拉荷马州俄克拉荷马城被起诉，罪名为利用美国邮政系统实施诈骗计划。他缴纳了25,000美元保释金，但未于1933年2月6日出庭受审，地点为美国俄克拉荷马西区地方法院，随后成为在逃犯。约一周前，本办公室收到美国邮政部提供的信息，表明 Julian 先生可能在中国。邮政部及司法部请求协助将其逮捕并遣返美国受审（若其确在中国）。上周日下午试图逮捕 Julian 先生时，发现他持有一本看似加拿大护照的证件。因此，逮捕行动未能执行。为使贵处了解情况，现随函附上一份“通缉”通告，内含照片、指纹以及关于 Julian 先生的其他信息。Julian 先生还因侵吞200,000美元而被俄克拉荷马州当局通缉。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, THURSDAY, APRIL 27, 1933

“DOUBLE-CROSS”
ALLEGED

Oklahoma Lawyer Coming
for Julian Case

TO APPEAR AS STATE’S
ATTORNEY

Oklahoma City, Apr. 25.
Mr. O. A. Cargill, attorney and one of the men who deposited $25,000 bail for Mr. C. C. Julian, now in Shanghai, announced tonight that he will sail for China within the next ten days to “avenge a $25,000 double-cross.”
“I will go to Shanghai at my own expense and appear as attorney for the State of Oklahoma in order to extradite Julian,” Mr. Cargill said.
Mr. Cargill mentioned that, in addition to the charges that Mr. Julian used the mails to defraud, there is a charge that he embezzled $200,000 while serving as the sole trustee of the Julian Oil and Royalties Co.
Federal moves to accelerate extradition lagged, however, when it was learned that Mr. Julian had not been arrested and that, under **〔此处转录不清〕** hai, he could not be extradited on any United States warrant. There was no immediate hope that he could be extradited to Canada because he is not charged with violation of any Canadian law.
It was said, however that the prosecution was investigating to learn whether any Canadian investors in the Julian enterprise would make formal charges against him and thus permit his extradition to Canada.
Despite the assertions of Mr. Cargill, it is believed here that it will be impossible to extradite Mr. Julian on a state warrant.
The bonds for Mr. Julian’s release were furnished by Mr. Cargill and Mr. John Peacock, a Oklahoma oil producer.—United Press.

Mr. Julian Resting
Mr. Julian was not receiving callers yesterday evening, as he was having a good rest. He has been on a milk diet for the past day.
Friends state Mr. Julian did not see his legal representative, Dr. Fischer, yesterday, but would probably see him to-day. Also, it is possible that Mr. Julian may face a newsreel camera to-day, and give a message which will be heard in United States theatres next month.

“双重背叛”

俄克拉荷马律师将前来
处理 Julian 案

将以州检察官身份
出庭

俄克拉荷马城，4月25日电。
O. A. Cargill 先生是律师，也是为目前身处上海的 C. C. Julian 先生缴纳25,000美元保释金的人之一。他今晚宣布，将在未来十天内启航前往中国，以“报复一场价值25,000美元的双重背叛”。
Cargill 先生说：“我将自费前往上海，并以俄克拉荷马州律师的身份出庭，以求引渡 Julian。”
Cargill 先生提到，除了指控 Julian 先生利用邮件进行诈骗外，还有一项指控称他在担任 Julian 石油及特许权公司（Julian Oil and Royalties Co.）唯一受托人期间侵吞了200,000美元。
然而，当得知 Julian 先生未被逮捕，且根据**〔此处转录不清〕**海，他不能凭任何美国逮捕令被引渡时，联邦政府加速引渡的行动陷入停滞。由于他未被指控违反任何加拿大法律，因此立即将他引渡至加拿大的希望渺茫。
不过，据说检方正在调查，以查明 Julian 企业的任何加拿大投资者是否会对其提出正式指控，从而允许将其引渡至加拿大。
尽管 Cargill 先生如此声称，但此地认为，凭州逮捕令引渡 Julian 先生是不可能的。
Julian 先生的释放保释金由 Cargill 先生和俄克拉荷马石油生产商 John Peacock 先生提供。——合众社。

Julian 先生正在休息
Julian 先生昨晚未会见访客，因为他正在好好休息。过去一天他一直实行牛奶饮食。
友人称，Julian 先生昨天未会见其法律代表 Fischer 博士，但今天可能会见。此外，Julian 先生今天可能会面对新闻电影摄影机，发表一段下个月将在美国影院播放的消息。

（手写签名：Julian）

THE CHINA PRESS, THURSDAY, APRIL 27, 1933
Big Shot
L. A. Operations Recalled
In some circles, his sudden dis-
covery and subsequent announce-
ment of his whereabouts in the
press of Shanghai brought to mind
memories of a few hectic days in
1928 when Julian was taken before
the courts of Los Angeles to ans-
wer to charges of implication in one
of the most gigantic frauds in the
history of the western United
States. It recalled the sad figure of
Asa Keyes, district attorney who
prosecuted Julian as he was led
through the doors of San Quentin
Penitentiary to serve a seven-year
sentence, convicted of having re-
ceived a bribe from Julian's asso-
ciates. It brought to mind memories
of Jake Lewis, Julian's secretary,
who was sent to prison. Julian was
freed although he had been head
of the firm, the Julian Oil Com-
pany, involved in the scandal.
The Julian Oil Company at the
C. C. Julian
Gigantic Stock
Frauds Recalled
As Julian Found
Canadian Charged With
U. S. Federal Offense
Spends Hectic Day Here
By C. D. ALCOTT
Still reiterating his innocence,
staunchly maintaining that he had
been "framed," and that he in-
tends fighting efforts to take him
back to the United States to stand
trial in Oklahoma City on charges
of using the mails to defraud, C. C.
Julian yesterday spent the day in
his room at the Metropole Hotel,
receiving newspapermen, photogra-
phers, acquaintances and others in-
terested in the legal aspects of his
efforts to evade extradition.
A model host and apparently re-
lieved of the strain of living under
an assumed name, Julian discussed
his case in Oklahoma quite freely,
expressed the opinion that he
doesn't believe the American autho-
rities will be able to extradite him
since he is a British subject, and ad-
mitted that he might go into busi-
ness in this part of the world. The
nature of the business that he
might undertake in Shanghai, how-
ever, was not mentioned.
In the meantime, a detective
from the Criminal Investigation De-
partment of the Settlement police
force occupied a seat in the lobby
of the Metropole, inquiry revealing
that the officer of the law had been
holding down the same seat for the
past three days. Shortly after noon,
when Julian stopped granting in-
terviews and left the hotel to visit
his dentist, the detective also de-
parted, unknown perhaps to Julian.
Discovery Causes Sensation
Announcement that the real iden-
tity of T. R. King, who has been
stopping at the Metropole for the
past month, was none other than
C. C. Julian of the Oil Company, O.
C. Julian Oil Royalties Company and
other oil enterprises, the man who
jumped a U. S. $35,000 bail in
Oklahoma City the day before he
was to stand trial on complaints
filed by 300 angry investors that
he had used the United States mails
to defraud them of their money,
furnished Shanghai with a new
sensation.
time was supposedly one of the
foremost independent oil organiza-
tions on the Pacific Coast. It was
capitalized at U. S. $100,000,000 its
head and founder C. C. Julian, was
a colorful figure throughout the
southwest and California and his
enterprise seemed sound. Collapse
came when it was discovered that
U. S. $50,000,000 in watered stock
had been placed on the market and
sold to all and sundry from office
boys and washwomen to financiers.
The stock had not been authorized
by the State of California and had
been placed on the open market
and apparently skyrocketed.
Rivals Famous Coups
The maneuver was sensational,
rivalling in method some of the
famous coups of Wall Street in the
old days when Jay Gould reigned
supreme over the Erie Railroad and
the New York financial kingdom.
The Julian Company stock, it was
brought out, was printed in a Los
Angeles job shop and the serial
numbers of the certificates issued
under the authorized capitalization
were duplicated on the bogus issue.
The stock was bucketed from the
curb to the Los Angeles Stock Ex-
change, prices advancing at a rapid
rate.
Discovery of the bogus issue was
not made for some time as a re-
sult of the duplication of serial
numbers. When it was discovered,
however, Julian was arrested and
placed on trial, Asa Keyes prosecut-
ing. Julian's trial was sensational.
A victimized Los Angeles public
demanded its pound of flesh and
with Asa Keyes prosecuting it was
content to sit back and watch
proceedings without creating
too much of turmoil. Keyes
was internationally known; had
skyrocketed to fame with his sen-
sational prosecution of Clara Phil-
lips, the hammer murderess.
Asked That Case Be Quashed
Julian's defense was that he had
signed the bogus issue of stock as
a matter of routine and that he
hadn't realized that it was bad,
just before the case was scheduled
to go to the jury, Keyes furnished his
enemies with the biggest "gasp" it
had in many years by asking that
the case be quashed due to insuffi-
cient evidence.

《大美晚报》，1933年4月27日，星期四
大人物
回顾洛杉矶行动
在某些圈子里，他突然被发现以及随后在上海报刊上公布其下落，让人想起了1928年那几天混乱的日子，当时 Julian 被带上洛杉矶法庭，就涉嫌参与美国西部历史上最大的诈骗案之一接受指控。这让人想起了 Asa Keyes 地区检察官的悲惨身影，他在起诉 Julian 后，看着 Julian 被带进圣昆廷监狱（San Quentin Penitentiary）服刑七年，而 Keyes 自己则因被判定收受 Julian 同伙的贿赂而入狱。这也让人想起了 Julian 的秘书 Jake Lewis，他被送进监狱。尽管 Julian 是卷入丑闻的 Julian 石油公司的负责人，但他获得了自由。
C. C. Julian
巨型股票
诈骗案回顾
随着 Julian 被发现
加拿大人被控
触犯美国联邦法律
在此度过混乱的一天
作者：C. D. ALCOTT
C. C. Julian 昨天在大都会酒店的房间里度过了一天，接待记者、摄影师、熟人以及其他对他逃避引渡的法律层面感兴趣的人士。他仍然重申自己是无辜的，坚决声称自己是“被陷害”的，并表示打算对抗将其带回美国俄克拉荷马城受审的努力，罪名是利用邮件进行诈骗。
Julian 表现得像个模范主人，显然摆脱了使用化名生活的压力，他相当自由地讨论了自己在俄克拉荷马的案件，表示他认为美国当局无法引渡他，因为他是英国臣民，并承认他可能会在这个地区做生意。不过，他并未提及可能在上海从事何种性质的业务。
与此同时，租界警务处刑事调查科的一名侦探坐在大都会酒店的大堂里，询问得知，这位执法人员过去三天一直守在这个座位上。中午过后不久，当 Julian 停止接受采访并离开酒店去看牙医时，这名侦探也离开了，Julian 或许并不知情。
发现引发轰动
宣布在过去一个月入住大都会酒店的 T. R. King 的真实身份并非他人，正是石油公司、O. C. Julian 石油及特许权公司及其他石油企业的 C. C. Julian。此人曾在俄克拉荷马城即将因300名愤怒投资者提起的投诉而出庭受审的前一天，跳保35,000美元逃逸，投诉称他利用美国邮政系统诈骗他们的钱财。这一消息给上海带来了新的轰动。
当时的 Julian 石油公司被认为是太平洋沿岸最重要的独立石油组织之一。其资本额为1亿美元，其负责人兼创始人 C. C. Julian 是整个美国西南部和加利福尼亚州的知名人物，他的企业看起来也很稳健。但当发现价值5,000万美元的掺水股票被投放市场，并卖给从办公室勤杂工和洗衣女工到金融家的各色人等时，崩溃随之而来。这些股票未经加利福尼亚州授权，却被投放到公开市场，并且价格显然飙升。
 rivaling Famous Coups（匹敌著名壮举）
这一手法轰动一时，其方法可与旧日华尔街的一些著名壮举相媲美，当时 Jay Gould 主宰着伊利铁路和纽约金融王国。据披露，Julian 公司的股票是在洛杉矶的一家印刷作坊印制的，伪造发行版上的证书序列号复制了授权资本额下发行的序列号。股票从路边交易厅对敲进入洛杉矶证券交易所，价格迅速上涨。
由于序列号重复，伪造发行的发现在一段时间后才得以实现。然而，当发现时，Julian 被捕并接受审判，由 Asa Keyes 提起公诉。Julian 的审判轰动一时。受害的洛杉矶公众要求严惩，而在 Asa Keyes 的公诉下，他们满足于袖手旁观，看着诉讼程序进行，而不造成太大的动荡。Keyes 国际知名；他因对“锤击杀人犯” Clara Phillips 的轰动性公诉而声名鹊起。
要求撤销案件
Julian 的辩护理由是，他签署伪造的股票发行只是例行公事，并没有意识到那是假票。就在案件预定提交陪审团之前，Keyes 以证据不足为由要求撤销案件，这让他的敌人多年来第一次感到最大的“震惊”。

In the meantime, Keyes was encountering election difficulties and his showing in the Julian case had left many of his constituents in an ill frame of mind. Lewis was convicted and sentenced to San Quentin. Then came the conviction of the printer and his sentence.

The collapse of the Julian Oil Company and the trial of Julian and Lewis had furnished Los Angeles and the whole of the United States with a sensation of unusual proportions. But it was given a greater one when Asa Keyes was taken into custody on charges of having accepted a bribe from the Julian crowd. The arrest was made following evidence produced by Lewis, angered at the outcome of his trial and the prison sentence the court had handed down while the head of the firm had gone free and according to American law, could not be tried for the same offense twice.

**Prisoners Were Fastidious**

Keyes, it developed, had received a large sum of money, said to have been in the neighborhood of a quarter of million dollars in United States currency, not to mention a fine house and a new automobile and other sundry gifts. When last led from the court room, he was under sentence to go to San Quentin Penitentiary. But Keyes wasn't welcome at San Quentin. The warden and keepers didn't mind so much but the convicts did. There was a near riot when the former prosecuting attorney was led through the prison gates, the prisoners maintain-

ing that Keyes was not fit to associate with. He had sent many of them to the "big house."

The affair at San Quentin became serious and Keyes had to be placed under guard as a matter of protection. Finally, he was given solitary confinement as a precautionary measure against his being harmed by other inmates of the California bastile. Sentiment among the prisoners toward Keyes still remains the same, according to last word from that hapless person and he is still in a cell by himself with guards on watch to see that he comes to no bodily harm.

In the meantime, Julian found Los Angeles uncomfortable. He sought other fields, moving back into the Southwest but still in the oil business. And now he is wanted in Oklahoma on a federal charge, that of using the mails to defraud investors. Since his discovery in Shanghai, Julian has devoted most of the interviews he has granted to acclaiming his innocence. He has stated that he was the victim of a frame-up and that he made money for his investors.

Innocent or not, his arrival in Shanghai has furnished the city with a new thrill, momentary perhaps, but a thrill nevertheless. He has made plans to fight extradition and has retained Dr. O. 科斯特（Coast）作为朱利安石油公司（Julian Oil Company）的“红人”被捕并受审。与此同时，凯斯（Keyes）正面临选举困境，他在朱利安案中的表现使其许多选民对他产生了不满情绪。刘易斯（Lewis）被定罪并判处送往圣昆廷监狱（San Quentin）。随后是那名印刷商也被定罪并判刑。

朱利安石油公司的倒闭以及朱利安和刘易斯的审判，曾让洛杉矶乃至整个美国为之轰动。但当阿萨·凯斯（Asa Keyes）因涉嫌收受朱利安团伙贿赂而被拘留时，引起的轰动更甚。此次逮捕是基于刘易斯提供的证据，刘易斯因对自己审判结果及法院判处的监禁刑期感到愤怒——当时公司头目却逍遥法外，且根据美国法律，不能因同一罪行再次受审。

**囚犯们十分挑剔**

事实证明，凯斯收取了一大笔钱，据称金额约为二十五万美元，此外还有一栋精美的住宅、一辆新汽车及其他各种礼物。当他最后一次被带出法庭时，已被判处前往圣昆廷监狱服刑。但凯斯在圣昆廷并不受欢迎。狱长和看守倒不太在意，但囚犯们却很介意。当这位前检察官被带入监狱大门时，差点引发骚乱，囚犯们坚持认为凯斯不配与他们为伍。他曾将许多人送进“大牢”。

圣昆廷的事态变得严重起来，出于保护目的，凯斯不得不处于警卫看守之下。最终，作为防止其受到加州这座“巴士底狱”中其他囚犯伤害的预防措施，他被单独监禁。据来自这位不幸之人的最新消息，囚犯们对凯斯的情绪依然如故，他仍独自关在一间牢房里，并有警卫监视以确保他不受身体伤害。

与此同时，朱利安觉得洛杉矶令人不适。他寻求其他发展领域，搬回美国西南部，但仍从事石油业务。如今，他在俄克拉荷马州因联邦指控而被通缉，罪名是利用邮件欺诈投资者。自从在上海被发现以来，朱利安在接受采访时大多致力于宣扬自己的清白。他声称自己是栽赃陷害的受害者，并称他为投资者赚了钱。

无论清白与否，他的到来给上海这座城市带来了一阵新的刺激，或许只是暂时的，但终究是一种刺激。他已计划对抗引渡，并聘请了 O. 费希尔（O. Fischer）博士作为其律师。《字林西报》代表昨日采访该律师时，他表示案件在法律层面没有新进展。从观察者的角度来看，这是一件复杂的事情，在最终解决之前可能会旷日持久。据说萨姆·英萨尔（Sam Insull）仍在希腊。

THE CHINA PRESS, WEDNESDAY, APRIL 26, 1933

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. B. REGISTRY
N. D 4806
Dn 27/4 #33

Julian, Wanted For
Alleged U.S. Fraud,
Found In Hotel Here

Oklahoma Oil Promoter
Protests Innocence,
Declares “Frame-Up”
In Federal Tribunal

Canadian Will Battle Ex-
tradition To America,
Retains Fischer To
Fight Return To States

Mr. G. C. Julian, fugitive oil promoter from the United States court at Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, is now in Shanghai under the name of Mr. T. R. King.

Mr. Julian, alias King, who is charged with having used the United States mails to defraud, has been living at the Metropole Hotel since March 23 and is registered there from Vancouver, B. C.

The China Press located Mr. Julian at the Metropole yesterday and found him a man protesting his innocence of all charges brought against him in the United States and determined to fight extradition to America to the last ditch.

“I was framed,” the fugitive oil promoter declared, “and am willing at any time to face U. S. court if given a fair chance to prove my innocence.”

Mr. Julian said he is Canadian and was born in Winnipeg.

Mr. Julian jumped bail in Oklahoma City on February 5, the day before he was to appear in court to be tried for allegedly defrauding 15,000 investors in the G. C. Julian Oil Royalties Company. His bail of G.$25,000 was forfeited and the court issued a warrant for his arrest.

**〔此处转录不清〕**

Confident Of Stay

Mr. Julian, a tall middle-aged man rapidly growing bald, has retained Dr. O. Fischer, local attorney, to fight his extradition from Shanghai. His confidence that he can remain here indicated that he studied the question before leaving America.

British authorities have made no attempt to arrest him although Settlement detectives are keeping a watch on him at the Metropole. Since there is no parallel Canadian law covering use of the mails to defraud as on the federal statutes of the United States, it is believed that the Oklahoma court will have great difficulty in bringing Mr. Julian back. American authorities are taking no action against Mr. Julian.

The oil promoter declares he has a Canadian passport.

“I think I shall stay in Shanghai,” Mr. Julian said last night. “I’ll go into business here, perhaps, and recoup my fortune. And then some day I’ll return to the United States and prove my innocence.

“I never swindled anyone. As a matter of fact I made money for many of the investors in my oil company.

“I was charged two years ago and have since been ready to stand trial but delays asked by the government prosecutors have prevented my case from being heard. And then, when the court seemed about to act, my friends told me that I was to be framed to the penitentiary and so I left.”

Mr. Julian said he went straight from Oklahoma to Vancouver and caught a Japanese boat for Shanghai.

“I’ve been recognized many times here by friends,” he said yesterday. “They know I’m the victim of persecution and advised me to get out of such a public place as the Metropole. I don’t think I can be returned to the States.”

Mr. Julian will confer with Mr. Fischer this morning.

According to word apparently received by the United States district attorney at Oklahoma City, Julian had been taken in custody in Shanghai.

During his career as an oil promoter, Julian has led a colorful life, operating both on the Pacific Coast and in the southwest. The G. C. Julian Oil Royalties Company **〔此处转录不清〕**

《字林西报》，1933年4月26日，星期三

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处
N. D 4806
日期 27/4 #33

涉嫌美国欺诈案的通缉犯
朱利安在上海某酒店被发现

俄克拉荷马州石油推广人
抗议无罪，宣称
在联邦法庭遭受“栽赃”

加拿大人将抗争
引渡至美国，
聘请费希尔以
抗拒被遣返回国

G. C. 朱利安先生，一名来自俄克拉荷马州俄克拉荷马城美国法院的通缉石油推广人，目前化名 T. R. 金（T. R. King）身处上海。

朱利安先生，又名金，被指控利用美国邮件进行欺诈，自3月23日以来一直住在麦特罗波尔酒店（Metropole Hotel），并在该酒店登记来自不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华。

《字林西报》昨日在麦特罗波尔酒店找到了朱利安先生，发现他是一位对在美国针对他的所有指控均表示无罪，并决心抗争到底以反对被引渡回美国的人。

“我是被栽赃的，”这位逃亡的石油推广人宣称，“只要给我公平的机会证明我的清白，我随时愿意面对美国法庭。”

朱利安先生称他是加拿大人，出生于温尼伯。

朱利安于2月5日在俄克拉荷马城弃保潜逃，那天本是他出庭受审的日子，他被控在 G. C. 朱利安石油特许权使用费公司（G. C. Julian Oil Royalties Company）一案中欺诈15,000名投资者。他的25,000加元保证金被没收，法院发出了逮捕令。

**〔此处转录不清〕**

自信能留下

朱利安先生是一位身材高大、迅速秃顶的中年男子，已聘请本地律师 O. 费希尔博士来对抗从上海将其引渡。他对自己能留在此地的信心表明，他在离开美国前已研究过这个问题。

英国当局尚未试图逮捕他，尽管租界巡捕房的侦探正在麦特罗波尔酒店对他进行监视。由于加拿大没有类似于美国联邦法规中关于利用邮件进行欺诈的平行法律，人们相信俄克拉荷马州法院将很难将朱利安先生带回。美国当局也未对朱利安先生采取任何行动。

这位石油推广人声称他持有加拿大护照。

“我想我会留在上海，”朱利安先生昨晚说。“我也许会在这里做生意，挽回我的财富。然后有一天我会回到美国，证明我的清白。

“我从未诈骗过任何人。事实上，我为我石油公司的许多投资者赚了钱。

“两年前我被起诉，此后我一直准备接受审判，但政府检察官要求的延期导致我的案件未能开庭审理。后来，当法院似乎即将采取行动时，我的朋友告诉我，我将被栽赃入狱，所以我离开了。”

朱利安先生说，他直接从俄克拉荷马州前往温哥华，并搭乘一艘日本轮船来到上海。

“我在这里多次被朋友认出，”他昨天说。“他们知道我是迫害的受害者，并建议我离开像麦特罗波尔酒店这样公开的场合。我认为我不会被遣返回美国。”

朱利安先生将于今天上午与费希尔先生会谈。

据俄克拉荷马城美国地区检察官显然收到的消息，朱利安已在上海被拘留。

在担任石油推广人期间，朱利安过着丰富多彩的生活，业务遍及太平洋沿岸和西南部。G. C. 朱利安石油特许权使用费公司 **〔此处转录不清〕**
